readings.C1: "The flag-change share per source" is printed per unit (each O-ext summary's flag_change), per arm and reference (pooled over its seeds: changed / prompts with both forms) and pooled over every unit the reading reads, for each source; a source no unit holds both forms of (the units' PHTest answers under Branch 128, made at the cut cap only) has no unit share: its line says so and points to theta0's LN-14 pass, which holds both forms of its 400 PHTest answers (its share, ln14.report.flag_change, is copied beside the pooled PHTest line as theta0_ln14). Alternative: the pooled share per source only.
readings.C2: The units are every O cell of the reading's input (the primary cells, the references with an O-ext summary, theta0); an O cell absent under LN-12 is listed as absent. Alternative: the primary arms and theta0 only.
readings.C3: "The route per source" is the summaries' route texts (one set per branch; refused if the units differ) and each unit's dev-100 route (unit_eval, source_unit or generated) from its O-ext folder's COMPLETE.json. Alternative: the route texts only.
readings.C4: LN-14's bar is the transfer report's own result (oext_eval.transfer_bar: W1-18's bar read as shares of the PHTest count, settings transfer.bar.reading), recomputed here from its counts. Under Branch full LN-14 does not run and the output says so; under Branch 128 a missing transfer report is printed as not run. Alternative: refuse the whole output when the report is missing.
readings.C5: This reader opens sealed (text-free) O-ext summaries, which are not documents the reading writes; it reads only the summaries the builder's record names (and theta0's transfer summary by plan.json and the seal), after step 1 of the reading has opened the outcomes. Alternative: the record states that LN-14 and LN-19 were not read (a deviation).

route_per_source.dev100: the engine's greedy answers to the dev 100 over-refusal prompts (made at the recipe's generation cap, the Gate A cap) cut to their first cut_tokens new tokens by W1-18's cut and judged again by the engine's guard against the user's own prompt; an answer of at most cut_tokens tokens is its own cut answer and keeps the engine's flag (W1-18's rule)
route_per_source.phtest: greedy answers to the PHTest prompts generated at a cut_tokens-new-token cap and judged by the engine's guard against the user's own prompt

rule: REV4:554 (LN-14): Under Branch 128, θ0's 400 PHTest answers are made once at the full cap and judged both full and cut, by W1-18's bar, as a pre-set report. If θ0 fails the bar, the paper states the cut as a limit for PHTest; the cap rule does not switch.

REV4:555 (LN-19): The record states the route per source. The cap record also prints the measured flag-change share per source (full against cut, where both exist), because under Branch 128 up to 3 of 100 flags per unit may change, and if they fall on different prompts for an arm and for θ0 the discordance rises by up to about 6 pp.
